content.text:
Parser benchmark on the 40 MB fixture, 10 runs each:

| Version | Median | p95 | Peak memory |
|---|---|---|---|
| main | 2.41 s | 2.58 s | 610 MB |
| streaming branch | 0.93 s | 1.02 s | 84 MB |

The streaming parser is about 2.6× faster and uses a seventh of the memory. Output is byte-identical on all 312 fixtures.
